verdict.rationale: The axis applies because LibreOffice is used as a headless, API-driven document-conversion engine, so job-completion callbacks are a fair question. However, the evidence documents only the CLI start parameters, headless mode and the UNO acceptor, and nothing describes registrable outbound HTTP callbacks or webhooks that notify a consumer when a job finishes. Building such notifications on the UNO API would be a developer building block, not the capability itself.
